headline: Ethiopia Central Bank Keeps Interest Rate at 16% Amid Money Supply Growth
summary: Ethiopia’s central bank has kept its benchmark interest rate at 16 percent despite a sharp acceleration in money supply growth.
why: Benchmark interest rate decisions by central banks dictate monetary policy stances, influencing commercial borrowing costs, inflation expectations, and currency valuation.

impacts.name: Ethiopia benchmark interest rate
impacts.why: The central bank maintained its benchmark rate at 16%.
